profile.ja: 対魔忍を率いる総隊長にして最強の対魔忍と目されている正義のくノ一。天才的な剣術と体術、人知を超える光速のスピードが武器。対魔忍養成学校・五車学園の校長を務めている。最近はすっかり裏方に徹しているが本当は現場に出たいタイプ。文字通りの神のいたずらで結婚もせぬまま妊娠してしまい、どうしたものかと悩んでいる。
profile.en: She is a justice-driven kunoichi who serves as the supreme commander of the Taimanin and is regarded as the strongest Taimanin. Her weapons are genius-level swordsmanship, unparalleled martial arts, and light-speed speed. She is the principal of the government-established Taimanin training school, Gosha Academy. Lately she's been working behind the scenes, but she really wants to be on the front lines. By a literal twist of fate she became pregnant without getting married, and she's now worrying about what to do.

text.ja: あの、少し話があるのだけれど……ええ、このお腹の事よ。こんなのあなたにしか相談できないでしょう？
text.en: Um, I have something to talk about… yeah, about this belly. I guess I can only confide in you about it, right?

text.ja: まさか私が妊娠するなんて想像した事も無かったわ……え？　も、もちろん本当よ？
text.en: I never imagined I'd get pregnant… huh? Of course it's real!

text.ja: 少しお腹が重いけれど、業務にも任務にも支障はないわ。でも、無理は禁物よね
text.en: My belly's a bit heavy, but it doesn't interfere with work or missions. Still, I shouldn't overdo it.

text.ja: このお腹の事は当然さくらにも言ったんだけど、それ以来あの子ずっと赤ちゃんグッズをネットで見てるのよ……
text.en: I told Sakura about this belly, and ever since she's been browsing baby gear online nonstop…

text.ja: さっき紫に会ったんだけど、白目を向いて泡を吹いて倒れちゃって大変だったわ。いくら頑丈とは言え心配になるわね
text.en: I just saw Shii; she was staring into the void, foaming at the mouth and collapsed. Even though she's tough, it worries me.

text.ja: 生活するのに不便はそんなにないのだけれど、お酒が飲めないのはちょっと寂しいわね。でも、この子のためにも我慢しなきゃ
text.en: Living isn't that inconvenient, but not being able to drink alcohol is a bit sad. Still, I have to endure it for this child.

text.ja: ううん、こう言うとき身近に子育てをしている人が少ないのは困りものね……初めてで分からない事ばっかりなのに
text.en: No, it's troublesome that there aren't many people around who are actually raising kids… I'm a first-timer and I don't know anything.

text.ja: そろそろ、父親としての自覚は出てきた？　ふふ、お父さんになるのなら、色々とやらなきゃいけないことは多いわよ？
text.en: So, have you started feeling a sense of responsibility as a father? Hehe, if you're going to be a dad, there are a lot of things you'll have to do.

text.ja: あんっ、もう、こんなにお腹が大きくなった私に欲情するなんて……♪　ほんと、エッチなお父さんね
text.en: Ahh, you getting turned on by how big my belly's gotten…♪ Really, you're such a lewd dad.

text.ja: 安定期に入るまでセックスはおあずけだけど、その分お口でたっぷりご奉仕してあげるから我慢して、んちゅっ、れろぉ♪
text.en: We have to hold off on sex until I hit my stable period, but in the meantime I'll give you plenty of oral service, so hang on—*kiss*—slurp♪

text.ja: お、おっぱいそんな吸っちゃダメよぉっ♪　この子が飲む分なのに、お父さんが全部飲んじゃうなんてぇっ、ああっ♪
text.en: N-no, don't suck my breasts like that! This is for the baby, and you're drinking it all up, huh—ahh!
